front.title: Landmark Distribution Point Fetching for Merkle Tree Certificates

abstract.t: This document specifies a mechanism for a relying party to retrieve Merkle-tree subtree consistency proofs needed to validate a landmark- relative Merkle Tree Certificate (MTC). An X.509 certificate extension identifies one or more Landmark Distribution Points (LDPs). A relying party requests a proof set from an LDP and validates the proof chain against a trusted, signed target checkpoint.
